newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 8.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on January 8:
WASHINGTON - Media General Inc of Richmond made a major move into the Northern Virginia newspaper market by agreeing to buy the daily Potomac News of Prince William County.

SAN FRANCISCO - Apple Computer Inc's chairman Gil Amelio pledged to lead the company into the next century with peerless technology, on the heels of the company's purchase last month of Next Software Inc.
WASHINGTON - A proposed merger of Chesapeake Bagel Bakery and BAB Holdings Inc has fallen apart because BAB could not secure financing.
CHICAGO - General Instrument Corp officials said they planned to split the business into three companies through a tax-free spin-off to shareholders in an effort to boost its stock market value.
WASHINGTON - Intel Corp planned to unveil new versions of its popular Pentium microprocessor designed to dramatically improve the speed of multimedia software.
